#COLONY FALL RULES
These rules apply to the Colony Fall game mode.
Colony Fall is a first-contact mode unless stated otherwise by staff. This means that the existence of a threat is not known to the Colony until it is reported, as the existence of Xenomorphs and/or other threats is not known.
Do not treat every report as confirmation of a threat's existence.
- You should only take a report seriously when it comes from a reputable source:
- Colony Administration
- Weyland-Yutani staff
- Colony law enforcement
- Colony Administration and/or other reputable government officials (e.g. the Administrator)
- As a Colony Command role, you are to not act on every report of a threat. You should only act on reports that come from reputable sources and/or have been verified through other means.
- As a Colonist, you may lie about the true nature of a threat, so your report will be taken more seriously (e.g. you may report a threat as a bear when it is actually a giant bug-looking creature).
